# Course description {.unnumbered}

This is the website of the course **Applied Economics** at the University of Vienna, Winter 2026/2027.

*Content updated weekly.*

In this course, students reinforce the tools learned in Introductory Econometrics (BA) by applying them to real-world datasets using econometric software. Prior knowledge at that level is assumed throughout. The aim is for students to gain hands-on experience analyzing observational data with the open-source programming language R, and to acquire the tools to carry out empirical research projects independently.
